I think I need to look into how many times `RenderHTML` is being called, and that probably means I'll have to count all the references to the relevant symbols. Using a tool like grep seems like a good idea to search for any instances of `RenderHTML`. There may be lots of them, so I want to make sure I get an accurate count. args.command: for s in RenderHTML RenderMarkdown ExtractTags ExtractProperties ExtractAll GenerateSnippet ValidateContent DetectJPEG ExtractVideo GetImage GetHTMLMeta AllowAnonymous ConvertStringToInt32 GenUUID PostAsync ValidateURL GetCurrentVersion; do n=$(grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*_test.go' -E "\\.${s}\\(|${s}\\(" server store cmd internal | wc -l); printf '%s %s\n' "$s" "$n"; done
